title: The 4 Best Space Heaters for Offices
h1: The 4 Best Space Heaters for Offices
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for space heaters for offices, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at space heaters for offices using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Vornado VH202 Personal Space Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: Vortex heat circulation fan, 2 heat settings plus fan-only mode, Cool-touch exterior.
strengths: Small footprint fits under most desks without blocking legroom
Cool-touch housing is safe for all-day close-range use
Vortex airflow warms the whole leg area instead of one hot spot
Simple two-switch operation with no settings to fuss with
limitations: No oscillation or thermostat dial, just two fixed heat levels
Not powerful enough to warm an entire office on its own

products.name: Dreo Solaris 317 Space Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 1500W PTC ceramic heating element, 34dB whisper-quiet brushless DC motor, Digital thermostat, 41°F to 95°F.
strengths: 34dB fan noise is quiet enough for video calls or a shared office
Digital thermostat holds a steady temperature through a workday
Oscillation warms a whole office rather than just under one desk
Remote control lets you adjust settings without leaving your chair
limitations: Larger footprint than a compact under-desk unit
Costs more than a basic desktop ceramic heater
Overkill if you only need to warm your feet, not the whole room

products.name: Lasko 754200 Desktop Ceramic Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 9.2-inch compact desktop design, Adjustable thermostat, 2 heat settings plus fan-only mode.
strengths: Small enough to sit directly on a desk next to a monitor
One of the least expensive options in this entire category
No assembly required, plug in and go
limitations: Fan noise more noticeable than the Dreo Solaris on the high setting
Lower editorial score than the pricier options here
features: Ready to use out of the box, no assembly

products.name: Lasko CT16450 Ceramic Space Heater
products.blurb: Key specs: 15.7-inch compact ceramic heater, 1500W element, Adjustable thermostat.
strengths: Taller than a desktop unit, so it warms more of a seated body
Compact enough to sit on the floor beside a desk without blocking a walkway
Adjustable thermostat beats a fixed-only desktop heater
limitations: Some owners report a noticeable low buzzing sound

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
